content.user_title: Optimize LLM Prompts and Agent Instructions
content.value_statement: Weak prompts create inconsistent model outputs and slow AI feature development. This skill helps structure prompts, examples, constraints, and output formats for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
actual_capabilities: Defines prompt sections for role, task, constraints, output format, and examples.
Adds few-shot input and output examples for desired style and edge cases.
Converts vague requests into clear system prompts for agents and AI features.
Specifies response formats and evaluation criteria for repeatable outputs.
Suggests iteration practices for testing and refining prompts.
limitations: It does not test prompts against live model responses.
It does not provide model-specific benchmark scores or latency data.
It does not replace safety review for prompts that handle sensitive data.
Final quality depends on the provided task details and examples.

use_cases.title: Design Agent Instructions
use_cases.description: Create structured system prompts for AI agents with roles, boundaries, and expected outputs.

use_cases.title: Improve Review Workflows
use_cases.description: Turn broad review requests into clear prompts with criteria, severity labels, and action-focused outputs.

use_cases.title: Standardize Prompt Patterns
use_cases.description: Document reusable prompt structures for teams that need consistent model behavior across workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Improve a Basic Prompt
prompt_templates.prompt: Optimize this prompt for clarity, constraints, and output format: [paste prompt]. Explain the key changes in simple terms.

prompt_templates.title: Create a System Prompt
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a system prompt for [agent or feature]. Include role, task, boundaries, inputs, output format, and two success criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Add Few-Shot Examples
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite this task prompt with three few-shot examples. Cover a typical case, an edge case, and a failure case.

prompt_templates.title: Design an Agent Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Optimize this multi-step AI workflow for [goal]. Define agent roles, handoffs, verification checks, and prompt sections for each step.

output_examples.input: Create a system prompt for a code review agent.
output: Defines the reviewer role and scope.
Lists security, performance, maintainability, and best-practice checks.
Requires severity, evidence, explanation, and suggested fixes for each issue.

output_examples.input: Improve a support triage prompt for inconsistent responses.
output: Adds clear ticket categories and escalation rules.
Includes examples for urgent, normal, and incomplete requests.
Specifies a concise response format for routing decisions.

output_examples.input: Add few-shot examples to a data labeling prompt.
output_examples.output: The optimized prompt includes representative labels, edge cases, rejection guidance, and a required explanation for uncertain decisions.

best_practices: Start with the user goal, available inputs, and required output before adding examples.
Include edge cases that show what the model should avoid or reject.
Test revised prompts with representative tasks before using them in production.
anti_patterns: Asking for better results without defining audience, constraints, or success criteria.
Mixing task instructions, examples, and formatting rules in one unstructured paragraph.
Treating a single good response as proof that a prompt is reliable.

faq.question: What does this skill optimize?
faq.answer: It optimizes prompts for LLM tasks, AI agents, system instructions, examples, constraints, and output formats.

faq.question: Can it create prompts for Claude and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides prompt structure that can be adapted for Claude, Codex, Claude Code, and similar LLM tools.

faq.question: Does it run benchmarks?
faq.answer: No. It provides prompt design guidance, but it does not execute tests or collect benchmark results.

faq.question: Does it support few-shot prompting?
faq.answer: Yes. It recommends input and output examples, including typical cases and edge cases.

faq.question: Can it help with system prompts?
faq.answer: Yes. It can structure system prompts with roles, task boundaries, constraints, and required response formats.

faq.question: Is this a safety review tool?
faq.answer: No. It can improve prompt clarity, but sensitive or high-risk workflows still need separate safety review.
